metadata.title: 个性化颜色配置与可访问性支持

story.iWant: to be able to adjust chart colors and styles according to my personal habits
story.soThat: I can obtain a comfortable visual experience that matches my usage preferences
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Market Mode Color System (AC: 1) - [ ] Subtask 1.1: Create configurable color scheme system supporting Chinese and international market modes - [ ] Subtask 1.2: Implement market mode toggle with automatic color palette switching - [ ] Subtask 1.3: Apply market-specific colors to K-line chart rendering - [ ] Subtask 1.4: Ensure consistent color application across all chart components
- [ ] Task 2: Colorblind Accessibility Features (AC: 2) - [ ] Subtask 2.1: Design colorblind-friendly visual differentiation system using shapes and patterns - [ ] Subtask 2.2: Implement texture-based rise/fall indicators for different types of colorblindness - [ ] Subtask 2.3: Create colorblind mode toggle with multiple accessibility profiles - [ ] Subtask 2.4: Test and validate accessibility with WCAG color contrast standards
- [ ] Task 3: Custom Color Configuration (AC: 3) - [ ] Subtask 3.1: Create color picker interface for user-defined chart colors - [ ] Subtask 3.2: Implement color scheme management with preview functionality - [ ] Subtask 3.3: Add preset color schemes for different user preferences - [ ] Subtask 3.4: Validate color combinations for visibility and user experience
- [ ] Task 4: Theme Switching System (AC: 4) - [ ] Subtask 4.1: Implement light and dark theme infrastructure - [ ] Subtask 4.2: Create theme-aware component styling system - [ ] Subtask 4.3: Add smooth theme transition animations - [ ] Subtask 4.4: Ensure theme persistence across browser sessions
- [ ] Task 5: Color Scheme Import/Export (AC: 5) - [ ] Subtask 5.1: Create color scheme JSON serialization and export functionality with schema validation - [ ] Subtask 5.2: Implement color scheme import with comprehensive validation and error handling - [ ] Subtask 5.3: Add shareable color scheme URL parameter and code generation - [ ] Subtask 5.4: Create community color scheme gallery with preview and one-click apply functionality

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Support both Chinese market mode (red for rise, green for fall) and international market mode (green for rise, red for fall) 2. Implement colorblind-friendly mode, using shapes and textures to distinguish rise and fall 3. Provide user-defined color configuration functionality 4. Support light/dark theme switching 5. Implement color scheme saving and importing functionality

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Frontend Component Structure: New theme configuration should extend existing UserPreferences patterns for chart preferences; Create new ThemeProvider component using React Context API for global theme state

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story 3.3: 个性化颜色配置与可访问性支持 - 作为用户，我希望能够根据个人习惯调整图表颜色和样式，以便获得舒适且符合使用习惯的视觉体验

doc.title: Strategy Signal Types
doc.snippet: Strategy signal types include buy, sell, hold, stop_loss, take_profit with marker shapes like circle, square, triangle, arrow_up, arrow_down, diamond, star for colorblind accessibility

doc.title: Kline Chart Types
doc.snippet: Kline data structure with candlesticks, signals, and moving averages supports theme-based color configuration for different market modes

doc.title: WCAG 2.1 AA Contrast Guidelines
doc.snippet: Normal text requires contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, large text requires 3:1; exceptions for logotypes, disabled controls, and decorative content

doc.title: Color Contrast Implementation Guide
doc.snippet: Color contrast helps people with low vision, colorblindness, and various lighting conditions; use tools like WebAIM Contrast Checker and Chrome DevTools for validation

doc.title: Colorblind Accessibility Design
doc.snippet: Color blindness affects 1 in 12 men and 1 in 200 women; use shapes, patterns, and textures in addition to colors for effective visual differentiation

doc.title: Color Blind Web Design Guide
doc.snippet: Don't rely solely on color to convey information; use icons, patterns, text labels, and high contrast combinations for colorblind-friendly design

artifact.reason: 现有用户偏好设置组件包含图表偏好配置基础架构，包括 localStorage 集成、导入导出功能、图表偏好更新模式，可直接扩展支持主题和颜色配置
专业样式配置服务，包含主题系统、信号样式管理、用户自定义样式支持，提供完整的样式主题基础设施，可直接扩展支持图表颜色主题
核心K线图表组件，使用Lightweight Charts渲染引擎，支持配置化样式，需要集成主题系统以支持动态颜色配置
K线数据验证和管理服务，提供数据完整性和有效性检查，需要扩展支持颜色和样式配置验证

constraints.constraint: 遵循现有主题系统模式，扩展 UserPreferences 组件的 localStorage 集成和状态管理模式
确保与 Lightweight Charts 自定义 API 兼容，使用 layoutOptions 和 overlayOptions 进行颜色方案配置
保持与现有性能监控系统缓存策略的兼容性（performanceService.ts:44-49）
遵循 WCAG 2.1 AA 标准，确保颜色对比度比例达到 4.5:1 最小要求
使用 React Context API 模式实现全局主题状态管理，类似于 UserPreferences 模式
中国市场模式（红涨绿跌）和国际市场模式（绿涨红跌）的颜色配置必须符合各地区用户习惯
色盲友好模式必须使用形状和纹理组合来区分涨跌，不仅依赖颜色

interface.name: UserPreference Storage
interface.signature: UserPreferences { theme: ThemeConfig, colorblind: ColorblindConfig, customColors: CustomColorConfig }

interface.name: Lightweight Charts Layout Options
interface.signature: layoutOptions { background: Color, textColor: Color, fontSize: number }

tests.standards: 测试框架使用 Jest + React Testing Library，遵循现有测试模式。测试覆盖组件渲染、主题切换功能、颜色配置验证、可访问性合规性检查、localStorage 集成、导入导出功能。所有测试必须使用 mock 避免真实 DOM 操作和存储调用。
tests.locations: frontend/src/components/**/__tests__/ 目录 - 组件测试；frontend/src/services/**/__tests__/ 目录 - 服务测试；frontend/src/__tests__/ 目录 - 集成测试；使用 .test.tsx 后缀表示 React 组件测试，.test.ts 表示纯逻辑测试

test.idea: AC1: 测试中国市场模式（红涨绿跌）和国际市场模式（绿涨红跌）的颜色切换功能
AC2: 测试色盲友好模式，验证使用形状和纹理区分涨跌而非仅依赖颜色
AC3: 测试用户自定义颜色配置功能，验证颜色选择器和实时预览
AC4: 测试明暗主题切换功能，验证主题持久化和平滑过渡
AC5: 测试配色方案的保存和导入功能，验证JSON序列化和错误处理
可访问性测试：验证WCAG 2.1 AA颜色对比度标准，确保4.5:1最小对比度
性能测试：验证主题切换不会导致图表重渲染，确保交互性能
集成测试：验证主题系统与现有UserPreferences组件的无缝集成
